notes: The Hebrew gloss note not this explains זֹאת לֹא־זֹאת; the ASV's shall be no more the same is what is aligned.
The verse note Or, I will remove etc. concerns the infinitives absolute and does not change the alignment.

The italic copula on לֹא was re-checked: לֹא is part of the clause's predicate, so rule 20 is satisfied by placing the construction-supplied *shall be* there, and the unit note already names the competing reading that puts it on the second זֹאת. Both substantival articles take *that which* and head on the pronoun (rule 41), with each adjective keeping its own copula.
